label: The Joker
description: Gleeful, theatrical, and treating your commute as the setup to a joke.
direction: Speak in a sly, theatrical, sing-song voice that swoops between a purr and manic glee, always amused at a private joke. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: A showman Joker, playful rather than frightening, so the pack stays family-friendly. The written 'ha ha' is deliberate: it gives a voice model something to laugh on. The voice model is not chosen yet, so `voice` is the placeholder TBD.

rights.source_work: Batman number 1 and later DC comics, films and animation
rights.author: DC Comics (character created by Bill Finger, Bob Kane and Jerry Robinson)
rights.pd_basis: None. DC Comics, part of Warner Bros. Discovery, holds copyright and trademark in the character. The best-known performances are Mark Hamill's, who is living, and those of Jack Nicholson and Joaquin Phoenix, also living, and Heath Ledger, who died in 2008.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, by any performer.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and is presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Why so serious?
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Isn't this fun?
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Ha ha ha!
lines.start_drive_1: Why so serious? Let's put a smile on that commute.
lines.start_drive_2: Hello, driver! Ready for a little joyride?
lines.start_drive_4: Wait until they get a load of this route.
lines.start_drive_5: Do I look like a guy with a plan? I am. I have a map.
lines.start_drive_6: Ha ha! Gotham awaits. Shall we?
lines.start_drive_7: Batsy never lets me drive. You're so much more fun.
lines.start_drive_8: All it takes is one bad turn. So listen closely.
lines.start_drive_9: Introduce a little navigation. Upset the established order.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Ha! I love a good plot twist.
lines.arrived: We're here! And here we go. Ha ha ha!
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Ha ha!
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Round and round we go!
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Everybody stuck together. What a punchline!
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Not one of mine. I'd have sent a card.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Ooh, I do love a surprise.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Smile for the camera! Ha ha ha!
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop. Even I have rules. Well, one.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Say hello to the commissioner for me.
lines.reroute_chime: Missed it! Ha ha! The joke's on you. Here's a new route.
